$$\vec{B'A} = -\sin\alpha\,(h,\,23), \qquad \vec{B'C'} = h\,(-\sin\alpha,\,-\cos\alpha)$$

Substituting (II) into this and using $25-529\sin^2\alpha=(5-23\sin\alpha)(5+23\sin\alpha)$, after cancelling the nonzero factor $(5-23\sin\alpha)$:

So $a=240$, $b=92$, $c=6$ (square-free), and:
